title: Two-letter Words
countingRule: Exactly two Ethiopic syllable-letter graphemes in the NFC-normalized dictionary headword. Attached Ethiopic combining marks do not add a letter. Spaces, punctuation, affix markers, Latin text and numbers are not stripped to manufacture matches. No words are shortened.
scope: All matching headwords in the downloaded Tigrinya dictionary snapshot, not an exhaustive inventory of the Tigrinya language. Inflected forms embedded inside entries are not added as separate headwords. Alternative headwords are retained; senses with the same spelling are grouped, not discarded.

source.name: Kaikki.org Tigrinya dictionary, extracted from English Wiktionary
source.attribution: English Wiktionary contributors; data extraction by Kaikki.org / Wiktextract. Headwords, dictionary glosses and romanizations adapted by filtering and grouping; no native approval or endorsement is implied.

worlds.name: Animals & nature
worlds.description: Things to spot in your world.

pictureLesson.notice: Look at the cow and its patches. Can you spot its ears?
pictureLesson.offline: Find a cow in a picture book together. Point to its tail.

pictureLesson.notice: This heart is a picture symbol. Can you trace its shape in the air?
pictureLesson.offline: Draw a heart shape with a grown-up. A native reviewer will check this picture association.

pictureLesson.offline: Find a banana in a book or at home with a grown-up.

pictureLesson.notice: Look at the clear glass. Can you point to the water inside?
pictureLesson.offline: With a grown-up, notice how light shines through a glass of drinking water.

pictureLesson.notice: Look at the rug and its pattern. What colours can you see?

pictureLesson.notice: Look closely at the rice in the bowl. Can you spot the little grains?
pictureLesson.offline: Find rice in a picture or look at some together with a grown-up.
